headline: Premier League live updates: Leeds host Tottenham in early match
description: Another weekend of European soccer is underway, with Leeds United hosting Tottenham Hotspur to kick off Saturday's Premier League action.

headline: Unai Emery: Michael Carrick's Man United the 'same level' as Barcelona
description: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery has said that Manchester United are the "same level as Barcelona," insisting Michael Carrick's side present a tough challenge.

headline: Man United approaching a crossroads: Back Carrick, or move on?
description: Michael Carrick is hanging on as Man United manager, but how much longer can he and the club carry on like this? Sunday's game vs. Villa might tell us everything.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool's Rio Ngumoha still a Bayern Munich target
description: Bayern Munich still have Liverpool and England winger Rio Ngumoha firmly in their sights. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Frank Lampard unhappy with 3 big referee decisions in Coventry loss to Everton
description: Coventry City manager Frank Lampard was annoyed that a trio of key decisions went against his side in their 3-1 loss to Everton on Friday.
